package snapshot

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/koopa0/yomihon/internal/vault"
)

// InstallParseFailureHTTPFixture poisons only the marked fixture, delegating
// other files to the actual parser. The child runs no background scanner.
func InstallParseFailureHTTPFixture(t testing.TB) {
	t.Helper()
	original := parsers
	t.Cleanup(func() { parsers = original })
	parsers.note = func(rel string, data []byte) *vault.Note {
		if strings.Contains(string(data), "PARSE_FAILURE_HTTP_POISON") {
			panic("<script>alert(1)</script> & parser token")
		}
		return original.note(rel, data)
	}
}

// RescanParseFailureHTTPFixture rebuilds the captured fixture synchronously.
func RescanParseFailureHTTPFixture(ctx context.Context, store *Store) { store.rescan(ctx) }
